## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle Liú-Sòng translation of the discourse on the seven kinds of wife — addressed by the Buddha to the proud daughter-in-law of Anāthapiṇḍika named Yùyē 玉耶 (Sujātā). This belongs to the four-fold cluster T141 / T145 / T146 / T147 / T125[51.9].

**Abstract**

T144 was produced during Guṇabhadra's Liú-Sòng career (435–468 CE), recorded in the frontmatter. The Indic source is presumed lost.
